title: Structure–luminescence correlations in Eu3+-activated Ba2LaVO6 and Ba2GdVO6 double-perovskite phosphors
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8051-8071
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09112H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mustafa İlhan, Sibel Gökçe, Lütfiye Feray Güleryüz, Mehmet İsmail Katı
Eu3+-doped Ba2LaVO6 and Ba2GdVO6 phosphors show host-dependent red emission. The La-based host favors unusual 5D0→7F4 emission due to its flexible lattice, while the Gd-based host exhibits dominant 5D0→7F2 emission with improved thermal stability.
